lawyer: Mr. Md. Abdul Majid.  For the petitioner. No one appears for the opposite parties.
parties:
Kobra Khatun & Ors. ----- Petitioner
Vs
Sree Haran Biswas & Ors ----- opposite party.
full_judgment: 3. The petitioner No. 1 and Sukhjan Nessa predecessor in interest of the petitioners No. 2(a) to 2(g) and the proforma opposite parties No. 3-6 instituted O.C. Suit No. 215 of 1981 in the Court of Subordinate Judge Pabna against the opposite party No. 1 for Specific Performance of Contract. It is further Stated that there was an agreement with opposite party No. 1 to sell the land measuring 6.36 acres appertaining to S. A. Khatian Nos. 165. 220, 264, 101 of Mouza Bakchar within P.S. Bera and land measuring .96 decimals appertaining to S. A. Khatian No. 103 of Mouza Dighalkandi within P.S. Bera totaling 7.32 acres for consideration of Tk. 95,000 executed a baina petra on receipt of Tk. 75,000/- and subsequently on 4.10.81 payment of the balance amount of Tk. 20000/- was made by the petitioners and proforma opposite parties to defendant opposite party No. I. But the opposite party No. 1 insptre of repeated takes he did not execute and register the sale deed and ultimately refused on 15.10.81 and for which the aforesaid suit was filed. Petitioners further case is that behalf of all the plaintiffs (petitioners) the proforma opposite parties Nos. 3-6 used to take all steps in above suit. The petitioner No. 1 used to reside at Dhaka with her husband a Govt. servant for most of the times. Sukhjan Nessa the predecessor in-interest of petitioners No. 2(a) to 2(g) was an old illiterate and pardanashin lady and quite unaware of worldly affairs as such the pro-forma opposite parties No. 3-6 were in trusted to make tadbir in the said Suit on their behalf with bonafide so belief. The petitioner No. 1 came to her father's house at village Maskhali on 25.12.85 and on 27. 12. 85 she asked the opposite party No. 3 about the progress and present position of their case and whereupon he replied that the suit has been compromised with the opposite party No. 1 and the suit' was dismissed accordingly externally purpled and non passed and sent her relation one Abui Hossain Mia to the court to ascertain the position of the case and learn him the petitioners came to learn about the dismissal of the Suit on 20. 5. 82 by solenama wherein the signatures of petitioner no. 1 and thumb-impression of Sukhjan nessa were found out actually those are not theirs and those have been forged by false personation. As a matter of fact: the petitioner no. 1 and Suhjan Nessa never filed any solenama nor put any signature or thumb impassion therein. The petitioner No. 1 and the heirs of Shukjan Nessa were under firm belief that the pro-forma opposite parties who used to take steps in the suit as before have done the mischief behind the back of the petitioners and the opposite parties No. 3-6 did never disclose to them before 27.12.85 and it thus the said opposite parties who collusively compromised the case with the opposite party No. 1 and upon stating the aforesaid fact, the plaintiff petitioners i.e. the petitioner No. 1 and the legal heirs of Sukhjan Nessa, being seriously prejudiced, filed an application on 26-1-86 under section 151 of the code of civil Procure before the Subordinate Judge for setting aside the forged solenama and for restoration of the original suit to its original file number within one month from the date of their knowledge. The learned Subordinate Judge upon hearing the parties was pleased to reject the said application on 13.9.88.
